create_bert_text_embeddings: create a BERTTextEmbeddings module with custom hidden size and vocabulary size for text embedding
build_bert_embeddings_with_roberta_offse: build a BERTTextEmbeddings module with offset position ids enabled for RoBERTa-style padding handling
run_forward_pass_embeddings: run a forward pass through BERTTextEmbeddings with input token ids to get word embeddings
create_position_ids_from_input: create position ids from input token ids using the create_position_ids_from_input_ids method
review_bert_embeddings_layer_norm: review the BERTTextEmbeddings class and its layer normalization and dropout configuration
